'''2009 Match Play Championship Day 1 Scott Lingrell LS Watch Your Step (V)''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Scott Lingrell]] at [[2009 Match Play Championship]] (Day 1).

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Watch Your Step (V) / This Place Can Be A Little Rough (V) (Virtual Set 9: Sanctuary Moon)|OVS9-24-Watch_Your_Step-remaster.webp|label=Watch Your Step (V) / This Place Can Be A Little Rough (V)}}
* '''Username:''' CRingwell
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Original VS16]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 1
